viewing_check: Check the font for cracks, chips, fill or burner-thread damage, hold up to light for colour and swirl pattern; check chimney fits and is original; look under the base and font for maker or patent marks (e.g. Eagle, Hobbs, Atterbury); check whether the font is threaded or cemented to the base and whether there is any electric conversion.
